items.title: 52115_Danny Barker oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Vats, yeah. [INTERVIEWEE] Vats. There's a big old what looked like a pot...

ctx.x: I'm getting the Billboard, because I'm checking on what's happening with the Hadicol. The next couple of weeks I looked in the Billboard, and there's Senator LeBeau sued by the companies, because they went down there to the plant in Lafayette to see how he was mixing it and what they had. They bought it sight unseen, they was so excited over the thing. Figured they had a (?), see. They went down there, and Senator LeBeau was there -- it was a fiasco, the paper said. When they got down there, Senator LeBeau had…

Vats. There's a big old what looked like a pot, you'd see them on some people's lawns. They used to make sugar cane; you know, granulate sugar. That's what he'd got. He'd got poor/four(?) Black people, men and women there, mixing castor oil, Alka-Seltzer, or salts and sugar, and it's a jive patent medicine -- juniper berries or something in there. And they're stirring it by hand and
